claim_scope: Exact slope-weighted speed-energy identity and strict outer-branch squared-speed fraction for all compact invariant measures; x-conditional regression. Previously published amplitude-excursion law is cited background.
integrity: Proof uses arbitrary generator test functions, orthogonal conditional projection, stationary differentiation of residual squares, a transversal-flow argument at the breakpoints, and equilibrium rigidity. Exact-rational verification checks algebra and classical thresholds only.
scientific_limitations: Compact invariant probabilities; no attractor-existence assertion.
The >1/3 bound is a squared-x-speed fraction, not residence time.
The amplitude crossing at |x|>3/2 was established in an earlier published self-reviewed result; not newly claimed here.
Accessible 2016 localization preview concerns a cubic variant; the full text remained inaccessible.
title: Stationary speed-slope balance and quantitative outer-branch activity in Chua's piecewise-linear flow
